title: Remove control collectives implementation
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #188617

Remove the private `_ControlCollectives` / `_StoreCollectives` APIs and their
backing C++ implementation. `ControlCollectives` was an abstract
`torch::CustomClassHolder` base class exposing store-based control-plane
collectives (barrier, broadcast_send/recv, gather_send/recv, scatter_send/recv,
all_gather, all_sum); `StoreCollectives` was the sole concrete implementation,
built on top of a `c10d::Store`.

These APIs are private (underscore-prefixed) and have no in-tree users beyond
their own test. A GitHub code search surfaced only vendored copies of PyTorch's
own source (site-packages, mirrors), no genuine downstream consumers, so the
removal is safe. This deletes the implementation, its pybind bindings, the type
stubs, the Python re-exports, the build source entry, and the test.

Test Plan:

CPU-only distributed build:

```
USE_CUDA=0 USE_DISTRIBUTED=1 BUILD_TEST=0 USE_FBGEMM=0 USE_NNPACK=0 USE_QNNPACK=0 USE_XNNPACK=0 USE_FLASH_ATTENTION=0 USE_MEM_EFF_ATTENTION=0 MAX_JOBS=96 CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache pip install -e . -v --no-build-isolation
```

Verify the symbols are gone and torch.distributed still imports:

```
python -c "import torch.distributed as dist; assert not hasattr(dist, '_StoreCollectives'); assert not hasattr(dist, '_ControlCollectives'); from torch.distributed import TCPStore, PrefixStore, FileStore; print('ok')"
```

Lint:

```
lintrunner -a
```

This change was authored with the assistance of Claude Code (an AI assistant).
